'''Army B''' was a unit of the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]]. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], it was sent to flank the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] during the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Grassy Plains]]. Army B was destroyed while [[Battle of the Naboo resistance base|attacking]] a [[Naboo Resistance]] [[Naboo resistance base|base]].

{{Military-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Army B appeared in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']]. It was later identified in a diagram of the Battle of Grassy Plains in the reference book ''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''.
